fields.label: Backup ID
fields.help: The ID of the alloydb backup.

fields.label: Cluster Name
fields.help: The full resource name of the backup source cluster (e.g., projects/{project}/locations/{location}/clusters/{clusterId}).

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Display Name
fields.help: User-settable and human-readable display name for the Backup.

fields.label: Location
fields.help: The location where the alloydb backup should reside.

fields.label: Type
fields.help: The backup type, which suggests the trigger for the backup.

fields.label: Encryption Config
KMS Key Name
fields.help: The fully-qualified resource name of the KMS key.
EncryptionConfig describes the encryption config of a cluster or a backup that is encrypted with a CMEK (customer-managed encryption key).
